newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says will examine Germany's Holzmann request.
newsitem.headline: EU says will examine Germany's Holzmann request.

text.p: The European Commission will examine Germany's request to have responsibility over the Holzmann case and if justified will agree to it, the spokesman for European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said.
"If we notice that it's not for us but for the German authorities we'll send it back," the spokesman said.
German construction firm Hochtief AG and Deutsche Bank AG announced on Tuesday they were pooling their shareholdings in Holzmann AG. Hochtief and Holzmann are Germany's largest construction firms.
The German Cartel Office immediately slammed the agreement, which gives control over Holzmann, and said it would ask the Commission to refer the case back to it.
The deal has not been formally notified to the Commission for clearance, but the companies' lawyers have already sounded the EU's competition services, EU sources said.
In assessing the German request, the Commission must decide whether the German construction market is "distinct" from the other EU national markets.
